environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on EKS with default container security context. Pod runs with default capabilities, no resource limits set, service exposed via NodePort on port 8080 with no authentication middleware. JMX remote enabled on port 9090 without authentication. Container image based on eclipse-temurin:17-jre with default heap settings (-Xmx2g).

config.ingress: NodePort direct exposure, no auth proxy
